title: elytranthe sumbawensis
intro: Elytranthe sumbawensis, commonly known as the Sumbawa vine or mountain climbing plant, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Apocynaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Elytranthe sumbawensis include its ability to relieve pain, reduce fever, and exhibit antioxidant and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
